name: signals-media-testbed
description: Testbed for @lightningrodlabs/signals-media: a WebSocket relay, a selftest/room page, a Tauri (WebKitGTK) shell, and a Chromium Playwright gate.

scripts.pretest: npm --prefix .. run build && npm run typecheck
scripts.//tauri: Required by the Android build, not a convenience: gen/android's rust gradle plugin shells out to `npm run tauri android android-studio-script` to build the cdylib, and without this script the Gradle task dies with `npm error Missing script: "tauri"`.
